theme: Light mode default with earthy tones (High contrast for outdoors)

typography.hierarchy: H1 text-3xl sm:text-4xl tracking-tight font-semibold, H2 text-2xl sm:text-3xl tracking-tight, H3 text-xl sm:text-2xl, Body text-base. Labels/Overlines uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-xs font-semibold
typography.instructions: Do not use Inter. Ensure tight letter spacing for headings. Add Google Fonts links for Work Sans and IBM Plex Sans in index.html.

colors.instructions: Use Deep Slate as the primary text color and background for headers/cards where contrast is needed. Soft Green is the primary action color. Clay is used for destructive/absent states.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Tactile flat UI. Dashboard cards should have a flat background with a crisp 1px subtle border. No muddy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle ambient shadows. Drop shadows only on floating elements like sticky bottom nav or modals.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px border-border on grid items and cards. Use nested radii.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only use for sticky headers or bottom navigation: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 with a 1px top border.

layouts.general: Mobile-first approach. For desktop screens, clamp the main container to max-w-md mx-auto with a subtle border to simulate a mobile app experience.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-4 to p-6 for containers. Bottom padding pb-24 to prevent bottom nav collision.
layouts.navigation: Fixed bottom navigation bar for core modules: Dashboard, Attendance, Workers, Ledger, Settings.
layouts.grids: High density grid for data, col-span-1 for stats, col-span-2 for charts.

components.buttons: Large touch targets required for outdoors. min-h-[48px] for buttons and inputs. Pill-shaped or rounded-md.
components.cards: Subtle roundness (max 8px). Avoid overusing cards; use borders to separate list items (e.g. workers list).
components.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn charts for the monthly expense chart. Use earthy colors (greens, slates) for data series.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, DatePicker. Do not use native HTML elements. Add large touch areas for checkboxes.
components.attendance_toggles: Custom segmented controls or large toggle groups for Present/Half-Day/Absent/Overtime to allow easy 1-tap logging.

motion.interactions: Micro-animations on click/press (e.g., active:scale-[0.98]). Hover states should lightly adjust background color.
motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in and slide-up for page content.
motion.accessibility: Focus rings must be visible. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

image_urls.description: brown field near tree during daytime
a person holding up a cell phone in a field

media.instructions: Do not use placeholder image services. Render these images with object-cover and a subtle dark overlay (bg-black/30) if text sits on top.

3d_libraries.usage: Not recommended for this offline-first, utility-focused agricultural app to preserve performance.
3d_libraries.instructions: Focus on crisp 2D data visualization (charts) and readable typography rather than 3D.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡�🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Always use provided images or icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
CRITICAL: Avoid using HTML-based components for advanced user interactions (dropdown, calendar, toast). Use Shadcn components.
